inputs: BK/Human Creative Owner chat approval on 2026-06-13 to proceed after reviewing the visualized Research reference

verify.name: Phase 4B Owner Review Run record validates

verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(AGENTS.md|research_notes/RN-2026W22-003-phase4b-complex-prototype-reference.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-031.json|runs/RUN-20260613-001.json|art_candidates/phase4b/asset_requirements.json|art_candidates/phase4b/asset_requirements.csv|art_candidates/phase4b/asset_manifest.json|art_candidates/phase4b/asset_manifest.csv|art_candidates/phase4b/reuse_preview.md|art_notes/AN-2026W22-006-phase4b-art-requirements-candidate-package.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-032.json|runs/RUN-20260613-002.json|owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-005-phase4b-scope-art-KR.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-033.json|runs/RUN-20260613-003.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must approve, redirect, or reject the Phase 4B scope/art review gate before any Implementation Work Package may authorize Godot changes.
acceptance_criteria: The owner review is Korean and self-contained enough for BK to judge without relying on English-only workflow text.
The review summarizes the Phase 4B screen, selected gameplay-readable asset roles, WP-032 reuse candidates, gaps, and risks.
The review clearly separates prototype scope/art reuse approval from final game concept, final art direction, production asset approval, launch readiness, and implementation authorization.
The review records BK's Decision as approve with constraints while keeping Implementation authorization as not authorized until a separate Implementation Work Package is approved.
The review lets BK approve, redirect, reject, or allow placeholder-only handling for hazard, collectible/progression item, goal marker, and section landmark roles.
No Godot files, art assets, research notes, QA reviews, Learning Cards, schemas, agent profiles, lifecycle moves, or git operations are changed by WP-033 execution.
notes: This Work Package creates the Phase 4B Korean owner review gate and records BK/Human Creative Owner's approve-with-constraints decision. It does not itself approve Godot implementation, final art direction, production asset usage, launch readiness, or external testing.
